```{r load config}

config_path <- file.path(
  "..",
  "data",
  "202609_tp_FAMES_GC-IRMS",
  "tp1-1_raw",
  "analyzed_data",
  "experiment_config.yaml"
)

lab_config_dir <- file.path(
  "..",
  "..",
  "sessions_lab_isotidy_config"
)

config <- load_IRMS_config(config_path, lab_config_dir)

raw_data_path <- file.path(
  "..",
  config$raw_data_dir,
  paste0(config$file_name, ".xlsx")
)

raw_gc <- import_gc_data(
  raw_data_path
)

schema_path <- file.path(
  "inst",
  "config",
  "peripheral_schemas.yml"
)

schemas <- load_peripheral_schemas(schema_path)

schema <- get_peripheral_schema(
  schemas = schemas,
  peripheral = "EA"
)

stds_reference_df <- config$stds_reference_df

```
```{r test adapter}

gc_data <- adapt_gc_data(
  raw_gc,
  isotope = "C13"
)

```


```{r test result}

result <- process_ea(
  raw_df = raw_ea,
  config = config,
  schema = schema,
  stds_reference_df = stds_reference_df,
  isotope = "C13",
  run_id = config$file_name,
  instrument = "EA",
  apply_mass = TRUE,
  apply_linearity = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

```

```{r save result}

saved <- save_ea_results(
  result = result,
  config = config,
  output_dir = "../data/202605_prelim_EA_experiment/analyzed_data"
)

```
